top_signals.title: FMCSA tests giving truckers power to pause 14-hour clock
top_signals.summary:
Federal regulators are moving forward with a pilot that could let truckers pause their 14-hour driving window for as long as three hours.

top_signals.title: FedEx to invest $150M for air cargo terminal in Delhi
top_signals.summary:
FedEx plans to invest $400 million at two airports in India to upgrade its air cargo facilities.
